Far from the cloak-and-dagger tactics seen in fiction, many real-world cyber breaches begin with something deceptively simple: a username and password.  According to Verizon's 2025 Data Breach  Investigations Report, leaked credentials accounted for 22% of breaches in 2024, outpacing phishing and even software exploitation.
